limitations: Cross-app clipboard history is impossible for a non-IME app on Android 10+ (CDD C-0-1: clipboard data only for the default IME or the focused app); only the last copy is readable
Clipboard clear snapshot comparison cannot distinguish two different non-text clips (both classify as NoText)
Long-drag edge auto-scroll ergonomics and full TalkBack/RTL walkthrough are not covered by automation
Device tests overwrite and restore the isolated test process clipboard; the daily package is untouched
